abstract: I document that the right tail of the firm size distribution systematically thickens with economic development. To rationalize this fact, I develop a parsimonious idea search model in which both aggregate growth and the firm size distribution are endogenously determined. The model features an asymptotic balanced growth path along which Gibrat's law holds at each date, and the right tail of the firm size distribution thickens monotonically toward Zipf's law. The model also implies that policies favoring large firms can improve welfare by better utilizing the diffusion externalities arising from idea search.
abstract_zh: 本文发现，企业规模分布的右尾随经济发展系统性增厚。为解释这一事实，我构建了一个简约的思想搜寻模型，其中总量增长与企业规模分布均为内生决定。该模型具有渐进平衡增长路径特征，在此路径上各期均满足吉布拉定律，且企业规模分布的右尾单调增厚直至趋近齐普夫定律。模型还表明，偏好大企业的政策可通过更充分利用思想搜寻产生的扩散外部性来提升社会福利。

official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study the economic effects of transfers to local governments using a reform of the Finnish municipal grant system as a source of exogenous variation. We find that higher grants lead to lower municipal taxes and fees, higher public spending and improved budget balance. These changes in local fiscal policy lead to an increase in private sector jobs. Our estimates imply a cost per job of e33,000. The increase in jobs is paired with a reduction in commuting to other municipalities. The effect on migration seems small, suggesting grants bring local benefits without drastically affecting where households choose to live.
abstract_zh: 我们利用芬兰市政拨款制度改革作为外生变动的来源，研究了对地方政府转移支付的经济效应。研究发现，更高的拨款导致市政税费降低、公共支出增加以及预算平衡改善。这些地方财政政策的变化带来了私营部门就业岗位的增加。我们的估算显示，每个就业岗位的成本为33,000欧元。就业增长的同时，通勤至其他市镇的人数有所减少。对迁移的影响似乎较小，这表明拨款在带来地方利益的同时，并未显著改变家庭居住地的选择。

official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper studies the effects of income taxation on entrepreneurship, empirically and in a structural macro model with entrepreneurial choice. Combining state-level tax data with household and firm data we document that higher and more progressive taxation has a strong negative impact on entrepreneurial activity across time and space. To explain this relationship and to evaluate the impact of taxation on output and welfare, we develop a life cycle, incomplete markets model of the labor market with entrepreneurial choice. The model generates elasticities of entrepreneurship to taxation that are similar to those found in the empirical analysis.

title: Beyond health: a systematic review of cross-sector economic implications of school-based mental health programmes in Europe
title_zh: 超越健康：欧洲学校心理健康项目跨部门经济影响的系统综述
authors: Wendel, Flora, Walbaum, Magdalena, Finger, Celina, Brettschneider, Christian, Jung-Sievers, Caroline, Knapp, Martin, Rehfuess, Eva A, Asaria, Miqdad
official: 官方在线 2026-06-25 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Objective To assess the economic evidence on school-based prevention and mental health promotion interventions, focusing on costs and outcomes across key societal sectors, including healthcare, education, social care, criminal justice, as well as in productivity and individual expenses. Design A systematic review with narrative synthesis was conducted following the Synthesis Without Meta-analysis approach, including an assessment of monetised outcomes across all sectors and an additional analysis of non-monetised outcomes in the education sector. Study quality was appraised using Consolidated Health Economic Evaluation Reporting Standards (CHEERS) and Consensus Health Economic Criteria (CHEC). Data sources Medline, Embase, PsycINFO, Econlit, ERIC and Scopus. Eligibility criteria for selecting studies Economic evaluations of school-based prevention or mental health promotion interventions for children or adolescents in Europe that report outcomes across healthcare and other societal sectors. Results 20 studies were included, comprising different types of economic evaluations as well as trial-based and model-based evaluations. Based on the primary analyses reported in the studies, which consider costs and benefits across multiple societal sectors, most evaluations suggested favourable economic outcomes. Benefits exceeded costs in four out of five (80%) cost–benefit analyses (average cost–benefit ratio of 5.14). Half of the cost-effectiveness analyses found that interventions were more effective but also more costly than the comparator while two interventions were both more effective and less costly. In cost–utility analyses, 9 out of 10 (90%) fell below commonly used thresholds for good value for money. Reported outcomes covered healthcare, education, social care, criminal justice sectors, as well as productivity and individual expenses. Pronounced cost savings from included interventions were observed in productivity and healthcare, with improvements also observed in non-monetised education outcomes. Study quality was mixed. Conclusions School-based mental health interventions yield cross-sectoral economic benefits and, in many cases, societal returns on investment, in both the short and longer term, by influencing key determinants of health and well-being across multiple sectors.
abstract_zh: 目的 评估基于学校的预防与心理健康促进干预措施的经济学证据，重点关注关键社会部门（包括医疗、教育、社会照护、刑事司法）以及生产力和个人支出中的成本与结果。设计 采用无荟萃分析的综合方法进行系统综述与叙述性综合，包括对所有部门的货币化结果进行评估，并对教育部门的非货币化结果进行额外分析。研究质量采用《卫生经济学评价报告标准》（CHEERS）和《卫生经济学评价共识标准》（CHEC）进行评估。数据来源 Medline、Embase、PsycINFO、Econlit、ERIC 和 Scopus。研究选择标准 针对欧洲儿童或青少年开展的基于学校的预防或心理健康促进干预措施的经济学评价，且报告涉及医疗及其他社会部门的结果。结果 共纳入20项研究，涵盖不同类型的经济学评价，包括基于试验和基于模型的评价。基于研究报告的主要分析（考虑多个社会部门的成本与收益），大多数评价显示有利的经济结果。在五项成本-收益分析中，四项（80%）显示收益超过成本（平均成本-收益比为5.14）。半数成本-效果分析发现干预措施比对照措施更有效但成本更高，而两项干预措施既更有效又成本更低。在成本-效用分析中，90%（10项中的9项）低于常用的物有所值阈值。报告的结果涵盖医疗、教育、社会照护、刑事司法部门，以及生产力和个人支出。纳入的干预措施在生产力与医疗领域观察到显著的成本节约，同时在非货币化的教育结果方面也观察到改善。研究质量参差不齐。结论 基于学校的心理健康干预措施通过影响多个部门中健康与福祉的关键决定因素，在短期和长期内均能产生跨部门的经济效益，并在许多情况下带来社会投资回报。

title: Welfare Effects of Trade Associations: The Case of the Chilean Salmon Export Industry
title_zh: 贸易协会的福利效应：智利鲑鱼出口行业的案例
authors: Thomas Eisenberg, Manuel Estay, Debi Prasad Mohapatra
official: 官方在线 2026-06-25 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This article examines the welfare consequences of a trade association in an exporting country on consumers in destination countries. We estimate a structural model of the Chilean Salmon exporting industry that endogenizes firms' pricing and export decisions. Our results show that the trade association has a positive effect on consumer utility and involves higher marginal costs of production, consistent with higher quality products. Reduced form analysis estimates price effects associated with trade association membership of 3 to 8 percent. Our counterfactual analysis reveals that eliminating the trade association would reduce consumer welfare by 1.7 billion USD in destination countries.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了出口国行业协会对目的地国家消费者的福利影响。我们构建了智利鲑鱼出口行业的结构模型，将企业的定价与出口决策内生化。研究结果表明，该行业协会对消费者效用具有正向影响，同时伴随着更高的边际生产成本，这与产品质量提升的结论一致。简化形式分析估计，行业协会成员身份带来的价格效应为3%至8%。反事实分析显示，若取消该行业协会，目的地国家的消费者福利将减少17亿美元。

title_zh: 全球燃料冲击作为可持续出行行为变革的催化剂
authors: Pearson, Lauren, de, Ana Luiza Santos Sa, Gerhard, Robyn, Abrahams, Jamie, Nosratzadeh, Hossein, Cumming, Toby, Beck, Ben
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: A sharp rise in fuel prices in March 2026 created a potential window for sustainable travel behaviour change in Australia. Yet who is positioned to change how they travel remains poorly understood. A population-representative online survey of 2, 177 Australian adults, conducted in April 2026, captured pre-crisis travel behaviour, mode shift considerations, and conditions supporting sustained change. Explainable machine learning (XGBoost, SHAP, supervised k-means clustering) identified amenable subgroups for walking, cycling, e-bikes, and public transport. Three quarters of respondents had changed or considered changing their travel behaviour. Walking was the most commonly adopted new mode (20%), and travel avoidance the most common adaptation (41%). Financial hardship and younger age were dominant predictors of amenability. Supervised clustering revealed three recurrent archetypes - financially pressured young adults, employed urban professionals, and regional residents lacking service access. Realising equitable sustainable travel outcomes requires transport systems offering affordable, safe alternatives to all population groups.
abstract_zh: 2026年3月燃油价格急剧上涨，为澳大利亚可持续出行行为转变创造了潜在窗口。然而，哪些人群具备改变出行方式的条件仍鲜为人知。一项于2026年4月开展的针对2177名澳大利亚成年人的全国代表性在线调查，捕捉了危机前的出行行为、出行方式转变考量及支持持续改变的条件。可解释机器学习（XGBoost、SHAP、监督k-means聚类）识别出对步行、骑行、电动自行车及公共交通具有适应性的亚群。四分之三的受访者已改变或考虑改变出行行为。步行是最常采用的新出行方式（20%），而规避出行是最常见的适应行为（41%）。经济困难与年轻化是适应性的主导预测因子。监督聚类揭示了三种反复出现的典型群体——经济压力大的年轻人、在职城市专业人士及缺乏服务覆盖的偏远地区居民。实现公平的可持续出行成果，需要交通系统为所有人群提供可负担且安全的替代方案。
